race.comment: ENTERPRISE PRIVATE (4) consistent staying gelding who returned with a slashing fifth from back in the field over 2020m at Doomben in BM70 company. Comes to hand quickly and looks placed to advantage today. SPENZALOT (7) is racing in career-best form and looks up to this stronger contest after saluting over 2100m at Tamworth with the 61kg. Regular rider hops back aboard with the sharp weight drop. Can keep the winning momentum going. DOLLARS (6) ploughed through the heavy (9) going for a surprise 4.5 len win over 1600m at Gosford. Confidence is high and stays in the calculations. FAY'S ANGELS (5) drops in class after finishing seventh to the progressive Satono Jasmine over 1800m at Randwick in BM78 class. Proven here and maps well.
